provenance.Delta_Trigram: refit 2026-08-29 when the trigram scorer was replaced by the Katz-backoff model. Same 92,299 pairs and same univariate fit that produced the old 1.8816 / 77.09%, so this is a like-for-like upgrade on identical rows: 77.09% -> 89.52%. Almost all of the gain is the scoring function (<s> <s> padding and training-time normalization), not the model — the old pickle scored the new way reaches 82.14% against the new model's 82.16% on the app's 48,864 Paninian pairs. See trigram_compare/REPORT.md.
provenance.Delta_LSTMWiki50M / Delta_AdaptiveWiki50: added 2026-08-30 as NEW scorers beside lstm / adaptive_lstm, which keep their 1.820 / 1.822 weights unchanged so existing variants.csv files stay comparable. Fitted on the same 92,299 pairs as the rest. The gain over the older pair is 77.45% -> 92.60%, of which +5.65 is the scoring fix (<SOS>/<EOS> padding plus training-time normalisation) and +9.50 the retrained checkpoint (50.8M tokens vs ~2M; held-out perplexity 79.65 vs 380.71 on the identical split). The checkpoint stopped on a 25-minute training budget rather than convergence, so these are a floor. See D:/audit/lstm/FINDINGS.md.
